section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Any patent claim covering raw root powder, hydroalcoholic crude extract, or classical therapeutic uses (stress, anxiety, vigor, arthritis) is strictly barred under Section 3(p) and Section 3(e) due to prior documentation in TKDL.
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable under Section 2(1)(j): Novel standardized withanolide delivery systems (lipid nanoparticles, liposomal carriers, sustained-release microcapsules), verified non-obvious synergistic combinations, and novel extraction processes isolating specific purified fractions.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: CRITICAL REJECTION TRIGGER. Historic precedent: US Patent No. 5,401,504 for wound healing was revoked by USPTO upon TKDL submitting 32 classical citations. Any claim on Curcuma longa or crude curcumin for wound healing, skin inflammation, or blood purification faces an absolute Section 3(p) bar.
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: High bio-availability formulations overcoming curcumin's poor water solubility (SEDDS, phytosomes, phospholipid complexes), synthetic curcumin analogs, or novel non-obvious combinations with statistical synergism.

botanical_name: Ocimum sanctum L. / Ocimum tenuiflorum L.
section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Any patent claiming Ocimum sanctum extracts or blends for respiratory ailments, viral fevers, or cough is barred by TKDL references under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Isolated active fractions (e.g., eugenol-depleted rosmarinic acid concentrates) with proven synergistic antiviral activity, or proprietary aerosolized pulmonary delivery devices.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: CRITICAL REJECTION TRIGGER. Historic revocation of European Patent EPO 436257 (anti-fungal neem extract) by EPO Board of Appeal based on traditional knowledge. Any broad fungicidal, insecticidal, or topical antibacterial claims on neem extract are rejected under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Novel solvent-free selective azadirachtin extraction processes yielding zero toxic residue, or stabilized nano-emulsions for non-agricultural dermatological applications.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Any claim covering guggul resin for cholesterol lowering, lipid management, or joint pain is barred under Section 3(p) as traditional knowledge.
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: High-purity E- and Z-guggulsterone isolation and standardization processes, novel enteric formulations preventing gastrointestinal irritation, or synthetic derivatives.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Uses for chronic fever, immune stimulation, and liver tonic are heavily documented in TKDL. Claims on crude Guduchi starch (Satva) or aqueous extract are barred.
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Standardized arabinogalactan polysaccharide fractions with validated targeted cytokine-modulation assays, or shelf-stable liquid formulations preventing degradation of active tinosporoside.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Patent claims on Asparagus racemosus for female reproductive health, lactation enhancement, or gastric ulcers face direct Section 3(p) objections.
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Purified shatavarin IV-enriched extracts demonstrating enhanced pharmacokinetic bioavailability, or controlled-release formulations for menopausal hormone regulation.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Any composition claim for cognitive enhancement, Alzheimer's prevention, or memory boosting using Bacopa monnieri is rejected under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Bacoside A and B enrichment processes achieving >55% purity with heavy metal remediation below 1 ppm, or blood-brain barrier (BBB) crossing liposomal nano-carriers.

botanical_name: Phyllanthus emblica L. / Emblica officinalis Gaertn.
section_3p_prior_art_trigger: ABSOLUTE BAR. Primary ingredient of Chyawanprash and Triphala. Claims on vitamin C retention, antioxidant capacity, or hair vitality using raw amla juice/extract are completely barred under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Low-temperature vacuum microwave drying retaining polyphenolic stability, isolated low-molecular-weight hydrolyzable tannins (emblicanin A & B) in standardized therapeutic complexes.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Any patent claiming bowel regulation, wound washing, or digestive tonics using Haritaki is rejected under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Standardized chebulagic acid fractions demonstrating targeted matrix metalloproteinase (MMP) inhibition in osteoarthritis.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Third component of Triphala. Throat lozenges or cough syrups containing crude Bibhitaki extracts are rejected under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Standardized bellericanin/gallic acid complexes with targeted uric-acid lowering (xanthine oxidase inhibition) properties in gout therapeutics.

botanical_name: Terminalia arjuna (Roxb. ex DC.) Wight & Arn.
section_3p_prior_art_trigger: CRITICAL REJECTION TRIGGER. Landmark traditional cardioprotective herb. Any patent claiming Terminalia arjuna bark extract for heart failure, angina, hypertension, or ischemic heart disease will be struck down under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Standardized arjunic acid / arjunetin sub-lingual delivery wafers or micro-emulsions showing rapid absorption during acute myocardial ischemia.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: ABSOLUTE BAR. Dry ginger is extensively documented for nausea, motion sickness, digestive fire, and joint stiffness. Barred under Section 3(p) and Section 3(e).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: High-concentration 6-shogaol and 6-gingerol stabilized nano-capsules protecting volatiles against gastric acid breakdown.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: CRITICAL REJECTION TRIGGER. Classical Ayurvedic concept of 'Yogavahi' (catalytic bioavailability enhancement). Any claim asserting piperine enhances drug absorption without unexpected synergism is barred under Section 3(p) as traditional knowledge.
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Novel synthetic piperlongumine derivatives with proven selective cancer-cell apoptosis and zero toxicity to healthy cells.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Throat lozenges, gastric ulcer healing syrups, and skin lightening creams using crude licorice extracts are barred under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Deglycyrrhizinated licorice (DGL) delivery formats retaining anti-ulcer efficacy without triggering mineralocorticoid-induced hypertension, or isolated glabridin skin-carrier lipids.

botanical_name: Eclipta alba (L.) Hassk. / Eclipta prostrata (L.) L.
section_3p_prior_art_trigger: CRITICAL REJECTION TRIGGER. Primary Ayurvedic hair-growth drug. Any patent claim claiming Eclipta alba for preventing alopecia, hair fall, or premature greying is barred under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Standardized wedelolactone liposomal micro-emulsions demonstrating targeted hair follicle dermal papilla cellular uptake.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Classical use for hypertension and psychotic agitation (Unmada/Apasmara). Crude reserpine extractions face prior art objections.
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Ultra-purified ajmaline / serpentine fractions configured with targeted central nervous system receptor delivery with reduced depressive side effects.

botanical_name: Convolvulus pluricaulis Choisy / Evolvulus alsinoides (L.) L.
section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Charaka designates Shankhapushpi as the foremost among Medhya Rasayanas. Memory-enhancing compositions are barred under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Standardized scopoletin-enriched extracts formulated for neuroprotection against beta-amyloid aggregation in dementia.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Any broad antiviral, hepatoprotective, or malaria-fever claim using crude Andrographis extract is barred under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: High-yield standardized andrographolide crystallization techniques, or novel water-soluble andrographolide sodium bisulfite derivatives with improved therapeutic indices.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Essential constituent of Arogyavardhini Vati. Claims for liver cirrhosis protection, viral hepatitis, or jaundice treatment using Kutki face immediate Section 3(p) objections.
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Standardized kutkin (picroside I & II) enriched fractions extracted with supercritical CO2 and formulated for non-alcoholic fatty liver disease (NAFLD).

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Kidney and urinary diuretic claims on Boerhavia diffusa are barred under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Standardized boeravinone fractions demonstrating specific renal tubule protective properties in chronic kidney disease.

botanical_name: Gymnema sylvestre (Retz.) R. Br. ex Schult.
section_3p_prior_art_trigger: CRITICAL REJECTION TRIGGER. Classical sugar-taste suppressing drug. Broad anti-diabetic or pancreatic regeneration claims using Gymnema extracts face strict Section 3(p) objections.
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: High-purity deacylgymnemic acid oral films suppressing sweetness sensation for appetite regulation in obesity.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Crude resin extracts for arthritis, asthma, or ulcerative colitis are heavily cited in TKDL.
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Standardized 3-O-acetyl-11-keto-beta-boswellic acid (AKBA) enrichment up to >30% bioavailability complexes with enhanced joint synovial fluid penetration.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: ABSOLUTE BAR. Charaka famously declares: 'There is no curable disease on earth that cannot be cured by Shilajit when administered properly with milk.' Broad claims on energy, vitality, or testosterone support are barred under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Novel purification processes removing heavy metals (lead, arsenic, mercury) below 0.1 ppm while preserving native fulvic acid-dibenzo-alpha-pyrone complexes.

section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Landmark skin and blood-purifier. Claims on acne reduction, melasma treatment, or blood purification using Rubia cordifolia face Section 3(p) objections.
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Purified purpurin and alizarin fractions devoid of cytotoxic anthraquinones, formulated as targeted follicular acne-clearing gels.

botanical_name: Justicia adhatoda L. / Adhatoda vasica Nees
section_3p_prior_art_trigger: HIGH RISK. Historic origin of synthetic bromhexine and ambroxol. Any patent claim claiming vasicine or Adhatoda vasica for cough relief or bronchodilation is barred under Section 3(p).
patentable_innovation_window: Patentable: Semi-synthetic vasicine derivatives with enhanced metabolic half-life and reduced uterotonic side effects.
